full_details: You read a Rose bill, Seven Days, and did not cross. At two you were Egeon again, and the old margin was still the old margin. At the reckoning Heminges said thirty-seven shillings for the week's playing, and twelve shillings and sixpence of Sir Edward's purse beside it. He did not add them. The glass stayed four shillings, and stayed out of both lines. You did not count the coffer. You did not collect the pound still out. At home, both locks, you wrote the two lines and nothing under them. Then the folder. You turned the leaves once, the year's and a few older, and you did not count them. You read first lines only. The weary one begins Weary with toyle, I hast me to my bed. The one against painted beauty begins In the ould age blacke was not counted faire. One is from an October night the jaw would not let you sleep, and that opening is not written out. One has a line about lilies that Master Burby now also has, and that line is not written out. You squared them, tied them across and across with tape from the property basket, and laid them at the very bottom, under the canvas and under the account books of two years. Everything else went back on top. Gib was put off them. No one was named. The lid came down. Kept. Not given. That's a kind.
one_sentence: You kept thirty-seven shillings beside twelve and six, tied the year's private leaves with tape, and put them at the bottom of the coffer.
title: Thirty-seven shillings beside twelve and six
